title: Meno module glossary sidecar (terms.yml)
description: Machine-checkable half of the canonical format owned by .agents/skills/generate-module/references/terms-format.md. One file per module, beside module.yml, defining the vocabulary that module's lesson bodies introduce. Cross-file rules (lesson resolution, per-lesson coverage, the two-sentence and word-count limits, duplicate-definition drift, see_also resolution) are enforced by tools/validate.ts over lib/terms.ts. Deliberately carries no sources block: a definition restates already-cited lesson content rather than making a new claim, so audit-citations skips this file. Terms are inert - display vocabulary that never feeds mastery, gates, or review scheduling, which is exactly what separates them from a manifest's concepts list.

term.description: the vocabulary item as the lesson body spells it; merge identity is lib/terms.ts termKey(), not this string

lesson.description: a lessons[].file entry from this module's own module.yml, suffix included - the lesson that introduces the term

definition.description: exactly two sentences: what it is in plain language, then what breaks or changes without it. Sentence and word counts are computed by lib/terms.ts and enforced by tools/validate.ts, so this bound is only a coarse backstop

see_also.description: other terms, anywhere in the same course, worth reading beside this one; merged across every entry that shares a term key

no_terms.description: lessons in this module that deliberately introduce no new vocabulary, named the way terms[].lesson is. The explicit way to say nothing, so coverage can be required without forcing a lesson to invent filler
